verdict.line: You lose if you trade in open lane away from walls where your Tentacles can't spawn and Ornn's Volcanic Rupture chips you for free; you win if you fight near terrain, tag him with E (Test of Spirit) before he closes, and stack Q (Tentacle Smash) damage through his Living Forge resistances.

brief.thesis: E (Test of Spirit, 900 range) outranges Ornn's only poke tool, Volcanic Rupture (800 range), so whoever controls the terrain near the lane decides who lands first. Living Forge gives Ornn bonus Armor and Magic Resist from every item he buys, meaning your flat physical poke gets worse value than your spirit-tax damage does over time. At 49.3% across 856 games this is close to a coinflip on paper, but the data flags you with the solo-kill edge, which means isolated 1v1s near a wall swing your way if you force them.

theirWindow.what: Away from terrain your passive can't spawn Tentacles, so Volcanic Rupture's slow plus his follow-up autos chip you with no answer from you beyond a single E tax. Back off and reset the trade toward a wall instead of fighting in the open.

yourWindow.when: Near a wall right after he commits Q
yourWindow.what: Volcanic Rupture is down for 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s with nothing to re-slow or disengage with, so hit E (Test of Spirit) from range, then W (Harsh Lesson) in to proc nearby Tentacles and Q (Tentacle Smash) to stack their damage. The spirit echo plus empowered Tentacle swings outtrade anything he has until Searing Charge is back.

start.why: Highest-picked start at 63.9% with a 50.4% win rate over 659 games; the extra AD and on-hit sustain win short trades before his bonus resistances from Living Forge matter.

boots.why: 49.4% win rate over 520 games and the most-picked boots (54.6%); the magic resist blunts his R elemental and Bellows Breath damage, and tenacity shortens any knockup-into-CC chain from his E.

core.why: Shreds the bonus Armor his Living Forge passive grants, and stacking Rage off repeated Q/W procs keeps him armor-shredded for the whole fight.
The on-hit slow punishes him for walking up to contest your Tentacles, and the extra haste loops E into W more often.
Keeps you alive through a Searing Charge knockup-shockwave or an R elemental hit so you can finish the all-in instead of dying to it.

situational.when: he's leaning on his R elemental and Bellows Breath for damage, swap your third item here (61.5% win rate over 65 games)
he's out-scaling you into the late game and you need to smooth his burst instead of trading evenly
you want a sharper early all-in spike instead of a longer sustained fight

runes.keystoneWhy: Heals you on every proc, stacking on top of your passive Tentacle lifesteal, which keeps you ahead in the extended wall-skirmishes this matchup is built around.

summoners.why: Highest win rate (50.3%) and most-picked combo (68.8%) in this matchup; Teleport lets you reset after a wall all-in and come back with your tentacle setup already favoring you.

playing.title: Fight near walls only
playing.detail: Q (Tentacle Smash) and your passive Tentacles both need nearby impassible terrain. Walk the trade toward brush or a wall edge before committing, or you're fighting with half your kit missing.

playing.title: Open with E, not W
playing.detail: Test of Spirit (900 range) outranges Volcanic Rupture (800 range). Tag him from max range first, then leap in with W (Harsh Lesson, 4s cooldown) once the spirit tax is already ticking.

playing.title: Punish the moment his Q lands
playing.detail: Volcanic Rupture is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s cooldown; once it's down he has no ranged tool or slow left, making this your window to all-in with W into Q.

playing.title: Respect the wall-charge knockup
playing.detail: If he's near terrain and uses Searing Charge into it, the shockwave damages and knocks up everyone around him. Don't stand next to a wall he can reach mid-charge.

playing.title: Abuse his own magma pillar
playing.detail: Volcanic Rupture leaves a magma pillar after a short delay, and that pillar counts as impassible terrain for your passive. A well-timed Q near it can spawn a Tentacle he didn't expect.

playing.title: Watch the jungler, not just him
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read flags Ornn as strong at setting up ganks. Your solo-kill edge assumes a 1v1, not a 2v1, so play with vision before you commit to an all-in.

playing.title: Time all-ins around your R
playing.detail: Leap of Faith spawns a Tentacle per champion it hits. Once it's up (120/95/70/70/70s cooldown) your damage spikes hard enough to close skirmishes your laning alone couldn't.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and the 49.3% head-to-head win rate over 856 games are measured OP.GG data on the current patch; the terrain and cooldown-timing reasoning behind them is my own read, not part of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Illaoi has the upper hand in almost all instances against Ornn. However, Ornn is good at setting up ganks so always be wary of where the enemy jungler is at. You can even win skirmishes with enemy jungler if you use your abilities accordingly.
